sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: No Limit to Perfection - Part 9 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "It's never precise enough — you've got to hit the head on the first shot, not the twentieth. Go train, fighter. You'll pick up some serious sniper skills along the way."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 10 enemies with headshots while using bolt-action rifles

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +35,000 EXP
- +300 Bolt-action Rifles skill points
- 30 GP coins
- 1× Valuables crate (Rare)
- Unlocks achievement The Time to Live and the Time to Die
